import base64,sys,json,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,"/opt/hermes")
from tools import skills_tool
original=skills_tool.skill_view
served=[]
def capture(*args,**kwargs):
 result=original(*args,**kwargs)
 parsed=json.loads(result)
 if parsed.get("success"):served.append(parsed)
 return result
skills_tool.skill_view=capture
sys.argv=["probe_metadata.py","--require-description"]
exec(compile(base64.b64decode(''),"metadata_probe","exec"))
assert served and any("short_description" in json.dumps(x) for x in served)
print("SERVED_SKILL_METADATA="+json.dumps({"short_description_present":True,"content_sha256":[hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(x.get("content"),sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest() for x in served],"result_keys":[sorted(x) for x in served]}),flush=True)
